goal: Read docs/desktop-control-app.md and docs/agent-work/desktop-control-app-mvp.md, then implement a review-ready MVP desktop control app for Kolibri on an Ubuntu factory node. The app must feel like the current Codex-like Kolibri chat: chat-first workspace, bottom composer, right-bottom Control entry point, dense operator panels and Russian owner-facing language. Reuse the existing React/Vite frontend where practical, keep /app web/PWA build working, and add the smallest production-safe desktop shell or desktop mode. Control the factory only through Control Plane and GitHub/CI contracts: health, nodes, tasks, task detail, submit task envelope, cancel, annotate, drain/undrain and agent messages. Do not use ad hoc SSH as the product control path, do not read node-local artifacts directly, do not call worker-only lease/heartbeat/complete/fail endpoints as owner actions, and do not expose secrets. Include offline/degraded mode, GitHub/CI/Project integration or exact authenticated blocker, Ubuntu QA evidence, screenshots, changed files, verification commands, security notes and follow-up tasks.
role_goal: build the Ubuntu MVP desktop control surface that lets Владислав operate the Kolibri factory safely from a Codex-like chat UI

must_cover: Control Plane health, nodes, tasks, task detail, submit, cancel, annotate, drain and agent messages
GitHub PR, CI and Project visibility or Project sync pending blocker
offline and degraded mode with stale-cache labels
runtime_constraints: Ubuntu factory node implementation and QA
Control Plane remains source of truth
no direct node-local filesystem reads from the desktop app
no secrets in diff, logs, screenshots or result payloads

acceptance: Desktop app or desktop mode launches on Ubuntu; if packaging is blocked, result includes exact blocker, missing dependency and working dev shell evidence
Existing frontend web/PWA build still succeeds
First screen is a Codex-like chat workspace with bottom composer and right-bottom Control entry point
Control Panel shows Control Plane health, nodes, task summary, task detail and agent messages, with explicit degraded/offline states
Task Composer validates required envelope fields and can submit a task through POST /v1/tasks
Task Detail shows lifecycle state, attempt, lease owner, heartbeat, acceptance, result reference and safe artifact summary
Cancel and drain/undrain actions require confirmation and use Control Plane endpoints, not SSH
GitHub/CI/Project information is visible from task/result context, or the result reports Project sync: pending with the exact auth/scope blocker
Offline/degraded mode uses timestamped stale cache and never auto-replays destructive actions without fresh confirmation
Security redaction covers tokens, env files, private keys, cookies, auth cache and local paths in owner-facing summaries
Ubuntu QA report includes commands, versions, screenshots or documented tooling blockers, package artifact/checksum if built, and follow-up risks
